data.title: 克莱尔 · 暴雨深夜的古文字解密
data.description: 学园宿舍深夜窗外雷雨交加，台灯在凌乱的书桌上打下温暖光晕。克莱尔身着暗紫吊带单手托腮研读魔力图谱，眉峰微聚，专注又迷人。
data.location: cozy student dorm room at night, rain beating heavily against dark glass window
data.action: leaning over wooden desk covered with ancient scrolls and manuscripts, chin in palm, furrowing brows in deep scholarly concentration
data.lighting: 案头暖黄台灯与窗外闪电冷光
data.promptProse: Claire in a midnight camisole leans over research scrolls at her desk while rain lashes the window, lamp light warming her thoughtful expression.
data.animaCaption: Warm desk lamp light illuminates her bare shoulders and the ancient scrolls.
